BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Higher Education.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Limiting the cost of assigned textbooks for institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the cost of assigned textbooks for institutions of higher education; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.15 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: No institution of higher education may assign a student to purchase a textbook that costs more than one hundred dollars unless:
(1) There is no available and comparable alternative that costs less than one hundred dollars; and
(2) There is no available substitute through open course materials.
